title: RevenueRescueCallResult
description: Strict structured result schema for the Revenue Rescue CALL-E workflow. Enforces fail-closed dispositions and explicit escalation flags.

outcome.description: The final disposition of the call. 'failed' or 'no_answer' must trigger the retry cascade.

promised_date.description: The date the customer promised to update their payment method (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if outcome is 'payment_promised'.

dispute_reason.description: The specific reason for the dispute if the customer contested the charge. Null otherwise.

escalation_required.description: True if the call outcome requires human review (e.g., complex dispute, angry customer, or repeated failures). False if the automated workflow successfully resolved or scheduled the task.

notes.description: A brief, factual summary of the conversation, the customer's exact words regarding the payment, or the specific reason for a failed connection.
